Name: Skip Bus Fare
Author: Androxilogin
Description:
[b][UPDATE] 10/20/16 - [/b]Travel back and forth to and from the desert free of charge. Updated since there was a change in the desert.xnb with the new release.

[youtube]AAzVLrLoRAo[/youtube]

With this mod you will be able to travel back and forth to and from the desert free of charge. You can pass the road block and simply proceed through the end of the tunnel. From there you can either choose to walk back or ride the bus when the time is right. 

SPOILER ALERT: If you haven't completed the bundle in the community center, this will enable you to use the bus even though it's broken down right from the start of the game. 

[url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/339/]FixDesertBusStop[/url] by [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/2642839]DevilBro[/url] unintentionally used in the desert portion of this mod.
